title: Patient Hardship Discount Program Relief on Appointment Series Late-Cancellation Fees
content:
Financial Assistance Office clause on the late-cancellation fee of an Appointment Series for patients with a hardship determination.

**Clause.** The late-cancellation hardship share is 0 percent where the patient holds an approved Patient Hardship Discount Program determination whose effective date has arrived and whose expiry date has not passed at a level whose discount percentage is 75 or more, 100 percent less the level's discount percentage where such an approved determination in force discounts more than zero but less than 75 percent, and 100 percent where no approved determination is in force. The share is read as a percentage of the late-cancellation basis and multiplies it.

**In force.** A determination is in force on the assessment date when it is approved, its effective date is on or before that date and its expiry date is on or after that date. A determination expiring on the assessment date itself is still in force; one taking effect the next day is not yet.

**Records read.** The patient's Patient Hardship Discount Program determination: its status, effective date, expiry date and the discount percentage of its level.

| Approved determination in force, level discount percentage | Hardship share |
|---|---|
| 100 | 0 percent |
| 75 | 0 percent |
| 50 | 50 percent |
| 25 | 75 percent |
| 0 | 100 percent |
| no approved determination in force | 100 percent |

**Example (hypothetical figures).** An approved determination in force at a level discounting 50 percent, on a late-cancellation basis of USD 35.00: the share is 100 percent less 50 percent, that is 50 percent, and 50 percent of USD 35.00 is USD 17.50.
